figures.title: Three language-model roles with numerical planning and release checks
figures.caption: Three separate fresh Ollama calls per portfolio decision. Current contract fields are independently verified; numerical tools compute quantities and the execution gate controls permission. No repair mechanism is used.

figures.title: Recorded sales and the shared forecast in the two test weeks
figures.caption: Solid lines: recorded sales across each 30-series panel. Dashed lines: the shared numerical LightGBM forecast, fitted afresh at each weekly origin. The axes use different quantity conventions; heights must not be interpreted as comparable commercial demand. The LLM does not produce these forecasts.

figures.title: Components of the inventory operating-cost index
figures.caption: The primary index includes holding, unmet-demand penalties and expiry. Acquisition spend is reported separately. Ratios here use pooled demand; policy-mean tables use the mean of per-seed ratios.

figures.title: Supplier-reading accuracy across the controlled formats
figures.caption: Exactly 13 numerical fields are scored per supplier call: four fields for each of three suppliers, plus the daily budget. Supplier identity/coverage must also be correct for a complete extraction. This is controlled language, not an unrestricted commercial document corpus.

figures.title: Local model-call latency by role
figures.caption: Bars show median recorded call time; upper whiskers show the 95th percentile, not a confidence interval. The local model was warm following development. Hardware and integration costs were not monetised.

figures.title: Paired effects on demand fulfilment
figures.caption: Thirty paired simulation seeds, with two weeks aggregated inside seed; 95% bootstrap intervals. The structured comparator uses the same numerical tool and current rules, isolating the model-assisted interpretation/routing layer.

figures.title: Paired effects on the operating-cost index
figures.caption: Thirty paired simulation seeds, with two weeks aggregated inside seed; 95% bootstrap intervals. Cost changes are means of paired seed-relative percentages. The structured comparator uses the same numerical tool and current rules, isolating the model-assisted interpretation/routing layer.

figures.title: Held decisions in the completed study
figures.caption: A hold is an unexecuted decision, not a successful zero-order recommendation. The same deterministic budget, capacity, pack and minimum-order checks govern all arms.

figures.title: Correct selection of the declared business priority
figures.caption: Complete audited agent decisions: 1,260 total days and 300 active-promotion days per dataset. Overall accuracy is 98.97% for M5 and 87.46% for RetailNet; active-promotion accuracy is 96.33% and 47.33%, respectively. The difference exposes policy-selection errors despite accurate supplier reading.
figures.kind: additional empirical summary of audited decisions
